analyst.summary: Tanla is a profitable, debt-free messaging-infrastructure business trading at a below-market multiple (~15x earnings) for its return profile (25% ROE). Full-year profit growth was close to flat despite double-digit revenue growth, though the most recent quarter showed a clear improvement as its newer Wisely AI fraud-protection platform scales. We rate this a Hold: the balance sheet and returns are excellent, but revenue growth has been modest and the path to reaccelerating it depends on unproven new-platform monetisation.
